mapper.select: select exists(select 1 from ar_version_deletion where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid) and completed_at is null)
select exists(select 1 from ar_version_deletion where scene_id=cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) and request_key=cast(#{requestKey} as uuid))
select exists(select 1 from ar_version_deletion where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid) and completed_at is not null)

mapper.insert: insert into ar_version_deletion(version_id,scene_id,request_key,actor_id,actor_name) values(cast(#{id} as uuid),cast(#{sceneId} as uuid),cast(#{requestKey} as uuid),#{actor},#{actorName})

mapper.select: select scene_id::text as "sceneId",actor_id as "actorId",actor_name as "actorName" from ar_version_deletion where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid) and completed_at is null
mapper.update: update ar_version_deletion set failure_reason=#{reason} where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid) and completed_at is null
update ar_version_deletion set completed_at=now(),failure_reason=null where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
